title: Copilot Notebooks: JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout details match Microsoft's notice and the roadmap, and its Cloud Policy path and preview Graph automation are documented. It reports the conflicting licence wording and confines the remaining gaps to image-specific controls, pricing and storage details.

claims.claim: TCM automation for this setting is a preview capability in Microsoft Graph beta.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta. These resources also support remediation and applyOnce.

claims.claim: Setting mode to applyOnce makes the monitor apply its desired-state baseline once.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in monitorOnly mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in applyOnce mode.

claims.claim: The baseline resourceType for this setting is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.claim: The resourceVersion for this setting is 1.
claims.quote: All resources on this page use resourceVersion: 1 and are singletons.

claims.claim: The resource's properties.value takes string 0 to disable or string 1 to enable the setting.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting.

claims.claim: TCM supports the Copilot Cloud Policy settings only in tenant-level policies.
claims.quote: The 20 Copilot resources are Office Cloud Policy Service (OCPS) settings. TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: Configuring the target setting in any group-level policy causes TCM operations for that resource to fail.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite for this resource's applyOnce operation.
claims.quote: microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | AI Administrator

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the required least-privileged signed-in user role for this resource's applyOnce operation.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, AI Administrator is the least-privileged Microsoft Entra role for the signed-in user. This role requirement applies to the user, not to the TCM service principal.

claims.claim: Use of the Graph beta APIs in production applications is not supported.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.
